schema.t0: First US trading session in which markets could react (base = prior close).
schema.selection: curated: initial set (2026-10). gpr_spike: scripts/gpr_candidates.py rule (z >= 3.0, 30-day gap, not within 10 days of a library event), attributed to the event that started the coverage within the 7 days before the spike. official: dated official announcement in an under-represented type, chosen without looking at the market reaction and not within 10 days of a library event.

events.name: 미 해군 구축함 콜호 자폭 테러
events.description: Suicide boat bombing of the USS Cole in Aden harbor kills 17 US sailors, amid escalating Israeli-Palestinian violence.
events.note: GPR spike 2000-10-13 (z 3.7). Attack at 11:18 Aden time, before the US open.

events.name: 미·영 이라크 바그다드 인근 공습
events.description: US and UK aircraft strike Iraqi air-defense and command sites near Baghdad.
events.note: GPR spike 2001-02-19 (z 3.5). Attribution low confidence; strike time unverified, t0 set to the same day to avoid using post-event prices as the base.

events.name: 9·11 테러
events.description: Hijacked airliners strike the World Trade Center and the Pentagon; US stock markets close for four sessions.
events.note: GPR spike 2001-09-12 (z 7.4). NYSE closed Sep 11-14; t0 is the reopening on Sep 17.

events.name: 부시 UN 연설(이라크 무력 경고)
events.description: US president tells the UN General Assembly that action against Iraq will be unavoidable if it does not disarm.
events.note: GPR spike 2002-09-13 (z 3.5). Speech in the morning ET (time not verified).

events.name: 이라크 전쟁 최후통첩
events.description: US president gives Saddam Hussein 48 hours to leave Iraq; invasion begins two days later.
events.note: GPR spike 2003-03-18 (z 3.3). Address at 20:00 ET after the close; t0 is the next session.

events.name: 미국 금융기관 테러 경보 격상
events.description: US raises the terror alert for financial institutions in New York, Washington and Newark after surveillance plans are found.
events.note: GPR spike 2004-08-03 (z 3.6). Attribution low-medium confidence. Announced Sunday; t0 is Monday.

events.name: 런던 지하철·버스 연쇄 폭탄 테러
events.description: Coordinated suicide bombings on three London Underground trains and a bus kill 52 people.
events.note: GPR spike 2005-07-08 (z 5.7). First blasts about 08:50 London time, before the US open.

events.name: BNP파리바 펀드 환매 중단
events.description: BNP Paribas freezes three funds exposed to US subprime assets; the ECB injects emergency liquidity.
events.note: Official announcement in the Paris morning, before the US open.

events.name: 리먼 브라더스 파산
events.description: Lehman Brothers files for bankruptcy; global interbank funding markets freeze.

events.name: 미국, 동유럽 미사일방어 계획 철회
events.description: US scraps the planned missile-defense sites in Poland and the Czech Republic, citing a revised Iranian threat assessment.
events.note: GPR spike 2009-09-18 (z 3.2). Announced about 10:20 ET, during the session.

events.name: 성탄절 미국행 여객기 폭탄 테러 미수
events.description: A man tries to detonate explosives on a Northwest Airlines flight approaching Detroit; security alerts follow.
events.note: GPR spike 2009-12-29 (z 3.3), attributed to the event that started the coverage (start-event rule). Christmas holiday; t0 is Monday.

events.name: 그리스 국채 투기등급 강등
events.description: S&P cuts Greece's sovereign rating to junk and downgrades Portugal, deepening the euro-area debt crisis.
events.note: Rating action during the US session.

events.name: 동일본 대지진·후쿠시마 원전 사고
events.description: Magnitude 9.0 earthquake and tsunami hit Japan; Fukushima nuclear plant damaged, supply chains disrupted.

events.name: 미국 신용등급 강등
events.description: S&P downgrades US sovereign credit rating to AA+ after debt-ceiling standoff, amid euro-area debt crisis.
events.note: Announced Friday after the close; t0 is Monday.

events.name: 버냉키 테이퍼링 시사
events.description: Fed chair tells Congress bond purchases could be reduced in the next few meetings; yields and the dollar jump.
events.note: Testimony during the US session.

events.name: 러시아 크림반도 군사 개입
events.description: Russian parliament authorizes use of force in Ukraine; Russian troops take control of Crimea.

events.name: 스위스 중앙은행 환율 하한 폐지
events.description: Swiss National Bank abandons the 1.20 franc floor against the euro; the franc jumps about 20 percent.
events.note: Announced 09:30 CET, before the US open.

events.name: 이란 핵합의(JCPOA) 타결
events.description: Iran and six world powers reach a nuclear agreement in Vienna, opening the way to lifting oil sanctions.
events.note: GPR spike 2015-07-15 (z 3.1). Announced in the Vienna morning, before the US open (time not verified).

events.name: 중국 위안화 전격 평가절하
events.description: People's Bank of China devalues the yuan by nearly 2 percent, triggering emerging-market currency selloff.

events.name: 파리 동시다발 테러
events.description: Coordinated Islamic State attacks in Paris kill 130 people; France declares a state of emergency.
events.note: GPR spike 2015-11-17 (z 4.4), attributed to the event that started the coverage (start-event rule). First attack about 15:16 ET, under an hour before the close; most of the reaction came on Monday.

events.name: 브렉시트 국민투표 가결
events.description: United Kingdom votes to leave the European Union; sterling collapses overnight.
events.note: Result known overnight; t0 is Friday.

events.name: 북미 군사 긴장 고조(화염과 분노)
events.description: US president warns North Korea of 'fire and fury'; North Korea threatens strike near Guam.
events.note: Remarks came just before 3 p.m. ET on Aug 8 (in session); markets reversed lower that day.

events.name: 미중 무역분쟁 개시(301조 관세)
events.description: US announces Section 301 tariffs on up to 60 billion dollars of Chinese imports; China vows retaliation.

events.name: 미중 관세 인상 예고
events.description: US president announces tariff increase on 200 billion dollars of Chinese goods, breaking trade-talk truce.
events.note: Announced Sunday; t0 is Monday.

events.name: 위안화 달러당 7위안 돌파
events.description: China lets the yuan weaken past 7 per dollar after new US tariff threats; the US labels China a currency manipulator.
events.note: PBOC fixing on the Asian morning of Aug 5, before the US open.

events.name: 사우디 아브카이크 석유시설 피격
events.description: Drone and missile attack knocks out about half of Saudi Arabia's oil output at Abqaiq and Khurais.
events.note: Saturday attack; t0 is Monday.

events.name: 미국, 이란 솔레이마니 사령관 사살
events.description: US airstrike in Baghdad kills Iranian commander Qassem Soleimani; Iran vows revenge.

events.name: 사우디-러시아 유가 전쟁
events.description: OPEC+ talks collapse; Saudi Arabia slashes prices and pledges to raise output, crude plunges about 25 percent.
events.note: Weekend announcement; t0 is Monday.

events.name: WHO 코로나19 팬데믹 선언
events.description: World Health Organization declares COVID-19 a pandemic; US suspends travel from Europe.

events.name: 러시아 우크라이나 침공
events.description: Russia launches full-scale invasion of Ukraine; Western sanctions follow, energy prices surge.

events.name: 영국 미니 예산안 쇼크
events.description: UK government announces unfunded tax cuts; sterling falls to a record low and gilt yields surge.
events.note: Statement about 09:30 London time, before the US open.

events.name: 실리콘밸리은행(SVB) 파산
events.description: Silicon Valley Bank collapses after a deposit run; contagion fears spread to regional banks.
events.note: Run began on Mar 9 after the Mar 8 capital-raise announcement; FDIC closed the bank on Mar 10.

events.name: 하마스의 이스라엘 공격
events.description: Hamas launches large-scale attack on Israel; Israel declares war on Hamas in Gaza.
events.note: Saturday attack; t0 is Monday.

events.name: 홍해 상선 공격으로 해운사 통항 중단
events.description: Houthi attacks on commercial ships prompt major shipping lines and oil companies to pause Red Sea transits.
events.note: Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd paused transits on Fri Dec 15 (intraday timing unverified); MSC followed on Dec 18.

events.name: 이란의 이스라엘 본토 공습
events.description: Iran launches hundreds of drones and missiles at Israel in first direct attack.
events.note: Saturday attack; t0 is Monday.

events.name: 엔 캐리 트레이드 청산
events.description: Global markets slump as yen carry trades unwind after Bank of Japan hike; Nikkei falls 12 percent.

events.name: 한국 비상계엄 선포
events.description: South Korea's president declares emergency martial law; parliament votes to lift it within hours.
events.note: Declared Tuesday night KST, during the US Tuesday session.

events.name: 미국 상호관세 발표
events.description: US announces sweeping reciprocal tariffs on nearly all trading partners.
events.note: Announced after the US close on Apr 2; t0 is Apr 3.

events.name: 이스라엘의 이란 핵시설 공습
events.description: Israel strikes Iranian nuclear and military sites; Iran retaliates with missiles.

events.name: 미국·이스라엘의 이란 공습 작전
events.description: The US and Israel launch a strike campaign on Iran; Iran retaliates with missiles and drones against Israel and Gulf states hosting US forces.
events.note: GPR spike 2026-03-02 (z 3.0). Saturday launch; t0 is Monday. Single-source details, verify against wire reports.
